ALTER VIEW [EDS].[Risk_Rating_Information] AS WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Business_Day_Flag ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC) AS RN
    ,* 
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
            ON FULLDATE <= CRM_DATE
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
    ) A
WHERE
--- Last n business days
    RN <= Rolling_Window
)
SELECT
RW.FullDate AS AS_OF_DATE,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT21,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT20,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT27,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.DTDATE1,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.MISCELLANEOUSID,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.BANK_ID,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.TYPE AS TYPE,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ACCOUNTID AS ACCOUNTID
FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
    LEFT JOIN eds.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO AS CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO
        ON CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
        AND SUBSTRING(CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
        AND CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.Type = 'Risk_Type'
---Fetch all records that per business day (snapshot)
        AND ((UPPER(RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA) = 'SNAPSHOT' AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_End_Date)
            OR (UPPER(RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA) = 'DELTA' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_Start_Date));
GO
